newsitem.title: USA: HFS names Hoenshell chairman/CEO of Avis.
newsitem.headline: HFS names Hoenshell chairman/CEO of Avis.

text.p: HFS Inc Monday said it named R. Craig Hoenshell, 52, chairman and chief executive officer of its Long Island, N.Y.-based Avis Inc., the world's second largest rental car system, effective immediately.
This new appointment reflects HFS's plan to take Avis public in the third quarter of 1997, when Hoenshell will become chairman and CEO of the new company.

Hoenshell joined American Express Co in 1986 as president of American Express Centurion Bank. In 1990, he became president of American Express Travelers Cheques before moving on to become president of American Express International in 1993.
